speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Mistress Ansell sent. I do not bring a razor into a close unless a woman with a stair has decided the court will see the chin.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I sent. He trims it himself, and himself is not a court. Sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Close, then. Once. I am not here to have anything drawn.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: I drew the tooth in October, and that one was paid. Today is a beard. Hold the stool, sir. A beard is not a tooth, and I am not keeping this one in a box.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave enough that a stage beard has something honest to sit over. I am not arriving at a chair with a naked face and calling it humility.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Close is close. You will still know your own chin in a glass. I know you players. Broth if you like, and no oaths in my ear.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you will not undertake a price on my stair. The cat is in the hall. A jaw is not bargained where a cat can hear the sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No price on the stair. I will know what I owe when I am looking at my own face, and not before.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Then I am done. The chair will not love you better for a bleeding lip. Think on your sins on the way. It distracts.
